notes:
Summary: HelixHaven is a mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for latency-sensitive customer-facing features. Started on Hosted API (Nov 2025) as quick POC for embeddings + reranking; now moved to Dedicated procurement for cost predictability and VPC requirement.

Key quotes: "We need predictable unit economics for our support assistant — spikes during product launches kill margins." — Head of Product.

POC results: hosted API POC ran Nov–Jan; evaluated chat + reranking. Observed: embeddings latency ~25ms (indexing), chat generation p95 ~220ms on hosted test traffic; quality acceptable vs Anthropic baseline for intent detection. Cost simulation shows 35–45% lower predicted TCO on Dedicated at projected traffic.

Requirements:
- Workloads: support-agent (real-time chat), doc-search (semantic retrieval), downstream reranking for search results.
- Latency targets: p95 end-to-end generation <200ms for chat, retrieval <100ms.
- Throughput: steady-state 120 qps for retrieval spikes to 420 qps during launches (30–45m windows).
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for key material, audit logs retained 1 year (ask: can we extend to 7y?), data residency in US only.
- Network: require VPC peering + restricted egress policy; need checklist for peering setup.

Pricing/packaging negotiation notes:
- Redwood proposed Dedicated commit: 4 reserved GPU pods (A100 equivalent) with guaranteed baseline throughput and 2-burst pods for traffic spikes.
- Proposed ramp: 3-month ramp (month1: 50% commit, month2: 75%, month3: 100%) with monthly usage review windows.
- Overage: proposed at 1.5x committed unit rate; HelixHaven pushing for step-down tiers (1.25x for up to 20% overage in a month).
- Burst policy: 2 pods in a shared burst pool with preemption priority; HelixHaven requests guaranteed minimum of 1 pod during major releases.
- Discounts: 12-month commit gets additional 12% off list; customer prefers 12mo vs 36mo given product uncertainty.
- Payment terms: Net-45 preferred; Redwood finance asking Net-30 for first year.

Timeline (recent):
- 2025-11-12: initial outreach, trial hosted API credit applied.
- 2025-12-03: Hosted API POC kickoff (support-agent sample dataset).
- 2026-01-18: Demo of dedicated architecture + autoscaling options (Carlos, Maya present).
- 2026-02-21: Pricing deep-dive + first draft Dedicated SOW (Fireflies ff_2026_02_21_8243).
- 2026-03-02: Security questionnaire answered; follow-up call with infra (ff_2026_03_02_9192).
- 2026-03-08: Internal execs reviewed proposal; finance requested detailed monthly cashflow and mid-year opt-out clause.

Evaluation notes:
- Tech fit: strong. Runtime performance and KV cache features align with their retrieval patterns.
- Cost: Dedicated likely to beat hosted at scale but requires commit and acceptable overage terms.
- Operations: HelixHaven needs clearer runbook for canary/fallback to hosted models during Dedicated maintenance windows.

Open action items:
- Update proposal to include stepped overage slabs (1.25x up to 20%, 1.5x thereafter).
- Add explicit 3-month ramp schedule and SLA for burst pool minimum 1 pod during release windows.
- Legal: insert mid-year review for usage and opt-out clause to appease finance.
- Security: confirm audit log retention limits and KMS key lifecycle details.

Next call: schedule 2026-03-18 10:00 PT (finalize commit + sign-off timeline).
